title: The polynomial ring over an abstract Setoid-flavored commutative ring is a module over it
statement: For any AlgS.CommRing record R, the coefficient functions Nat -> R.carrier form a module over R: AlgS.Module.IsModule R (AlgS.Poly.commGroup R) (AlgS.Poly.smul R). AlgS.Poly.commGroup R is the full sixteen-field additive AlgS.CommGroup of R[X] -- carrier Nat -> R.carrier, equivalence coefficientwise, every law field one application of R's corresponding field at the index -- and AlgS.Poly.smul R a p = fun n => R.mul a (p n). IsModule is the conjunction of five axioms: the scalar action respects both equivalences (smulCongrP, the obligation an Eq-flavored spine would get free), a . (v + w) ~ a.v + a.w, (a + b) . v ~ a.v + b.v, (a * b) . v ~ a . (b . v), and 1 . v ~ v. Each of the five is discharged here by ONE application of R's own field at the coefficient index: mulCongr, distribL, distribR, mulAssoc, mulOneL. This is the free R-module of countable rank, presented without a subtype, a quotient, or function extensionality.

formal.statement: theorem AlgS.Module.polyModule : ((x0 : AlgS.CommRing) -> AlgS.Module.IsModule x0 (AlgS.Poly.commGroup x0) (AlgS.Poly.smul x0))

evidence.supports: AlgS.Module.polyModule and the twenty-two other AlgS.Module.* / AlgS.idem_eq_e declarations admit through the trusted Kernel::add_declaration gate with an empty Kernel::axiom_footprint. The suite pins AlgS.Module.linComb and AlgS.Module.coeffAgree definitionally at bounds 0, 1 and 2 against hand-written terms, each with a negative twin (swapped summands, a bound one lower) that must NOT be def_eq; and it refuses polyModule's own proof term against the IsModule statement for the SELF module (R over itself), with the re-declaration against its own statement admitted in the same test as the positive twin.
evidence.checker_command: out=$(RUST_MIN_STACK=1073741824 cargo test -p axeyum-lean-kernel --lib --release module_setoid_tests -- --test-threads=4 2>&1) && test "$(printf "%s\n" "$out" | grep -cE 'test result: ok\. 8 passed; 0 failed')" -ge 1
evidence.notes: The pinned count is 8. The load-bearing member is the_poly_module_proof_does_not_check_against_the_self_module_statement -- without it the five coefficientwise proofs could be any well-typed module proof.

provenance.established_by: axeyum-lean-kernel nat_prelude::module_setoid, lane algebra-structures, ADR-1609 (roadmap W3-2).

notes: A module here is carried the way AlgS.Hom.* carries a homomorphism -- data as explicit arguments, axioms as a Prop -- and NOT as a record. The obstruction to a record is a universe one and is independent of quotients: nat_prelude::structures::declare_record admits a parameterless inductive at Sort 2 with one fixed level per FieldKind, so no record can hold another record, and shifting the levels wholesale would put the module's own carrier at Sort 2 where Nat -> R.carrier can no longer sit (this kernel's Sort hierarchy is not cumulative). DIMENSION is a further step and is blocked on AlgS.Field, which needs an apartness relation -- a separate open question (ADR-1588, ADR-1595). See ADR-1609.
